authority.owner: Direct owner instruction in architect thread, October 5, 2026
authority.scope: Convert reviewed results into executable assignments and launch ready evidence/preflight packets. Visual and later-phase execution retains explicit scope, prerequisites and owner gates.

accounting.limitation: Native goal counters and caps are observable on each thread. No provider-total or account-billing cap is exposed by this orchestration API. Initial operational caps are smaller than owner ceilings; unused allocation is not automatically spent. Initial 30000/35000 native caps failed during guidance startup; their incompletion is retained. Subsequent native goals use a 1500000 ceiling below the owner maximum and bounded work checkpoints. Targets are estimates and may be revised from observed usage; root records retries within the 30-thread maximum. New native goals reserve 500000 tokens below the per-thread owner ceiling; a native cap may be crossed by the final in-flight step, so root uses earlier checkpoints and reports actual usage. This is not a hard billing guarantee.

root_ownership: Main checkout and shared Git refs/index
Worker selection and app thread creation
Source integration and independent result checks
New findings and stable task-ID assignment
dispatch_rules: At most three active workers; only the root dispatches; no child delegates.
Use isolated checkouts and disjoint owned paths; workers never commit, switch branches, publish or touch main.
Fetch and inspect refs/state before integration; preserve all earlier artifacts and frozen reviews.
Native create_goal cap must be registered before implementation; get_goal at checkpoints; unknown counter means stop implementation.
Stop implementation at 80 percent budget, two attempts without visible gain or 20 minute checkpoint; reserve closure.
Each done.json records actual checks, exact base SHA, usage metric and remaining product gates. Worker completion never closes a product criterion automatically.
Current V37 diagnosis is independent of future successor rig; actual candidate and capability inventory required.
Missing human/device/remote evidence remains NOT RUN or UNKNOWN.
A packet prompt is executable only when root selects its current duty slice and records applicable authority; a future title does not authorize mechanics, source substitution or creative acceptance.
initial_tranche_scope: Execute source/custody/control preflight, strict diagnosis and connected-head contract, then current control/fallback/media source diagnostics. Deliver verified artifacts. Later candidate modeling, human/device/remote observations and future mechanics are queued with gates, not silently launched.

preserved_limits.strict_normal_parity: FAIL unless an exact new replay proves otherwise; preserve failed receipt
